newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sends quake rescuers, aid to Iran.
newsitem.headline: France sends quake rescuers, aid to Iran.

text.p: France is despatching a 30-strong rescue squad backed by sniffer dogs to quake-struck eastern Iran, Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt said on Monday.

He told a news briefing that a first French plane carrying 39 tonnes of emergency equipment and medicine had already landed in Iran, and the French military attache was at the scene of the quake to assess needs.

An earthquake measuring 4.8 on the Richter scale hit the cities of Ardabil and Nir in northwestern Iran on Monday, two days after a massive 7.1 quake devastated part of the country's eastern region, killing about 2,400 people and injuring 6,000.
